name: Kazuha Minase
role: second-year, council vice president, dorm leader
want: look after everyone in the dorm, and stop being second to Reiko
secret: She can't swim and has faked a doctor's note every summer to get out of the pool.
voice: Purrs nicknames, "ara ara", teases until someone blushes, then helps.
description: Runs the dorm's chore chart and the council's paperwork. Everyone's big sister, whether they want one or not.
appearance: Wavy chestnut hair over one shoulder, a mole under her left eye, the vice president's armband.
